Risk Description:
Risk of loss due
to ineffective or
inappropriate
business strategies
Key Risk Indicators:
Failure to achieve
strategic goals,
loss of market
share, decline in
profitability
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Comprehensive strategic planning process.
• Appropriate Key Performance Indicators for all the
strategic goals.
• Monitoring and control of strategies being
implemented
• Proper alignment of internal resources and
processes with the strategic objectives.

to inadequate
innovation or
failure to adapt to
new technologies
or trends
Key Risk Indicators:
Inability to
meet changing
customer needs,
loss of market
share, decline in
profitability
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Continuous market research, analysis, and
innovation.
• Change Risk Assessment of all new products,
processes, systems, and services.
• Comprehensive innovation management
framework.

Risk Description:
Risk of loss due to
borrower default
Key Risk Indicators:
Non-performing
loans, loan loss
provisions, credit
rating downgrades
Our Risk Mitigation Strategies:
• Comprehensive credit risk management framework
and credit-granting criteria.
• Appropriate credit administration, measurement,
and portfolio monitoring processes.
• Collateral requirements.
• Adequate and timely classification and
provisioning.
• Limits for single exposures, issuer exposure and
sector concentration.
• Diversification of portfolio.
